verdicts.reason: Both use the same three-column banner: a small jar on the left, the logo and 'Glow.' in the centre, and 'SHOP SOLSTICE' as two-line text on the right. In both, the CTA (call to action) breaks onto two lines and is too big next to the headline, the jar's 'SOLSTICE' label is unreadably small, and the side margins are uneven. A has about 85px on the left and 28px on the right, and its logo sits off-centre. B has a slightly bigger 'Glow.' and less uneven margins (about 60px vs 23px), so it holds together a little better.

These two are almost the same layout. Both have the same flaws: the CTA is wrapped onto two lines and competes with 'Glow.' as a second focal point, the jar is small and its label can't be read, and the left and right margins don't match. A's 'Glow.' is slightly larger and its jar sits a little closer to the left edge, which gives a marginally better hierarchy and balance than B (85px on the left, 28px on the right).
